limitations_and_boundaries: Organite assay uses embryonic day 4 chick limb bud cells; findings may be specific to this developmental stage and species.
In vitro/ex vivo conditions may not fully replicate in vivo mechanical and signaling environment.
Mathematical model simplifies cell-ECM and cell-cell interactions; parameters are phenomenological.
Wnt inhibition experiments rely on pharmacological agents; off-target effects possible.
Live imaging limited to fibronectin dynamics; other ECM components not tracked.
